name: Calculadora de Empréstimo
tagline: Calcule parcelas mensais e juros totais
description: Calculate monthly loan payments, total interest paid, and generate a full amortization schedule. Works for mortgages, car loans, personal loans, and student loans.
metaTitle: Calculadora de Empréstimo – Calculadora Gratuita de Parcelas Online
metaDescription: Insira valor do empréstimo, taxa de juros e prazo para obter parcela mensal, juros totais e tabela de amortização.

faqs.question: Como calcular a parcela mensal?
faqs.answer: Parcela = Capital × Taxa Mensal × (1+Taxa Mensal)^Prazo ÷ ((1+Taxa Mensal)^Prazo - 1)
